t: Time 3184Y white flexible cable provides reliable connectivity for heating control systems and multi-core applications in domestic environments. This 25m drum features 32 x strands per core delivering exceptional flexibility for routing through confined spaces and around heating equipment, with brown, black, blue and green/yellow colour-coded insulation for four-wire control circuits. The 1mm² conductors rated 300/500V and -15 to 70°C operating range ensure consistent performance in typical indoor heating installations.
